parts.description:
One native input representing one character of the root value.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/otp-field

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Optional native input type override; when omitted, `mask` chooses text or password.

inputs.name: aria-label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name override; later slots receive a generated character label by default.

parts.description:
Coordinates one native input per code point and a visually hidden native text control for
autofill, constraint validation, reset, and form submission.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/otp-field

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: The id applied to the first slot; subsequent slots receive `{id}-2`, `{id}-3`, and so on.

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of characters in the code. Required so server and client markup agree.

inputs.name: validationType
inputs.description: Character set accepted by the field.

inputs.name: normalizeValue
inputs.description: Additional normalization, applied between two validation passes. Keep this function idempotent.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Masks all slots unless an individual input supplies its own `type`.

inputs.name: autoComplete
inputs.description: Autocomplete hint used by the first slot and the hidden native input.

inputs.name: autoSubmit
inputs.description: Submit the owning form as soon as a complete user-entered value is committed.

inputs.name: inputMode
inputs.description: Software-keyboard hint. Defaults to `numeric` for numeric validation and `text` otherwise.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name used when this field participates in a native form.

inputs.name: form
inputs.description: Id of an external form that owns this field.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Whether the user can interact with the field.

inputs.name: readonly
inputs.description: Whether the value can be changed. Read-only slots remain focusable and navigable.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Whether a non-empty, complete code is required for native form submission.

inputs.name: defaultValue
inputs.description: Initial uncontrolled value. It is normalized before first render and restored on form reset.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Current value. Use with `[(value)]` for two-way binding.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Whether the control is invalid. A non-empty `errors` list also marks it invalid.

inputs.name: pending
inputs.description: Whether async validation is pending. Pending controls publish neither `data-valid` nor `data-invalid`.

inputs.name: touched
inputs.description: Whether the control has been touched. A `model()` so Signal Forms can write it; set on blur/focus-out.

inputs.name: dirty
inputs.description: Whether the value changed from its initial value. Merged with internal tracking.

inputs.name: errors
inputs.description: Validation errors for the control. A non-empty list marks it invalid.

outputs.name: onValueChange
outputs.description: Emitted before a user edit is committed. Call `eventDetails.cancel()` to reject the change.

outputs.name: valueInvalid
outputs.description: Emitted with the attempted pre-normalization text when a character is rejected.

outputs.name: valueComplete
outputs.description: Emitted after a user edit fills every slot.

outputs.name: touch
outputs.description: Emits when the control is touched, notifying Signal Forms (stable Angular 22 contract).

parts.description:
Visual and semantic separator between groups of OTP slots.

See https://base-ui.com/react/components/otp-field

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Orientation of this separator.
